DEN.reason: DEN has 1 row(s) but report_status is unfilled on every one. teammate_availability reads it, and an unfiled designation is not an absence of injury.

KC.reason: the team satisfies the frozen input contract

roster_identity_and_position.evidence_ceiling: The reduced vintage DROPS `status`, so the reduced blobs cannot answer roster membership at all and the raw retained files are the only source for it. A clock check alone is insufficient for this family: after a team plays, the vendor re-partitions ACT/INA, so `roster_status` runs a CONTENT check as well. That pair is the reference design for this module.

roster_status_and_name.basis: manifest raw_blob of the SAME capture

evidence.transactions_detail: `official_transactions` has no URL at all: 178 manifest row(s), all BLOCKED, zero bytes on disk. Signings, releases, IR placements and standard elevations are therefore NOT OBSERVABLE as events with their own effective time. A roster-vintage diff can show that a row appeared between two OBSERVATIONS; it cannot date the transaction, and it cannot distinguish a signing from a vendor correction.
evidence.never_emitted: GAME_ACTIVE -- no source we hold establishes it
